Explain screen sends visible screen text, or a screenshot when needed and your model supports images, to your configured AI provider. This may include messages and other private information. Password fields are skipped; screenshots are not sent when a password field is found. EQO keeps this context only while the explanation sheet is open, not in files or logs. Your provider may retain what you send under its own policy. Sharing is off until you allow it. You can switch it off in Explain screen settings.

Open the app you want explained, then tap the Explain screen Quick Settings tile or the EQO notification action. Add the tile using the pencil or Edit button in Quick Settings. Enable the notification in Setup → Explain screen settings. EQO cannot explain another app while its own window is covering it.
Turn on EQO in Android Settings → Accessibility to explain screens.
